description: This file defines a storage utility object that provides methods to interact with the browser's localStorage API, including get, set, and remove operations with error handling.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with the specified key from localStorage, returning a fallback value if an error occurs or the key does not exist.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in localStorage under the specified key, serializing it as JSON, with error handling for quota or serialization errors.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the item associated with the specified key from localStorage, ignoring errors if any occur.
